source.author: verg
source.text: Ergo iter inceptum celerant rumore secundo; labitur uncta vadis abies; mirantur et undae, miratur nemus insuetum fulgentia longe scuta virum fluvio pictasque innare carinas.
source.text_original: Ergo iter inceptum celerant rumore secundo; / labitur uncta vadis abies; mirantur et undae, / miratur nemus insuetum fulgentia longe / scuta virum fluvio pictasque innare carinas.
source.text_english: So they hasten their begun journey with favorable rumor; the pine ship glides along, oiled, over the shallows; the waves marvel, and the forest marvels, unfamiliar, to see the shining shields of the men far off and the painted vessels floating on the river.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: it pariter propulsa ratis; stant litore matres claraque vela oculis percussaque sole secuntur scuta virum, donec iam celsior arbore pontus immensusque ratem spectantibus abstulit aer.
reuse.text_original: it pariter propulsa ratis; stant litore matres / claraque vela oculis percussaque sole secuntur / scuta virum, donec iam celsior arbore pontus / immensusque ratem spectantibus abstulit aer.
reuse.text_english: The ship, driven on together, goes; mothers stand on the shore and, with their eyes, follow the bright sails and the shields of the men, struck by the sun, until the sea, now higher than the trees, and the vast air carried the ship away from the viewers.
